newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds drift lower, trade mainly spot.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds drift lower, trade mainly spot.

text.p: High protein soymeal sellers were around one stg down on the UK meals and feeds market on Monday following a lower close in Chicago at the end of last week.
However, buyers were not chasing the market.
"People are covered for March and April and unless they want to extend that cover by a day or two they have no reason to buy," said one broker.
"Almost every one seems happy to sit back and wait for the South American material to arrive," the broker added.
In thin trading A.D.M. rapemeal fetched 122 stg a tonne for spot on the resale market.
In Teignmouth EU sunmeal traded at 94 stg for spot while small loads of high protein soymeal were reported trading at the asking prices.
